args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, contradicting the docstring and
the FIN-212 requirement. tests/test_money.py expects half-even behavior
(e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66).

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g. 2.665 expected to round to 2.66, not 2.67).

## Change
- Switch the quantize rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212`: passed.
